objective.description: The deliverable and the business/communication goal it serves, e.g. 'landing page hero for Q3 pricing launch'.

source_artifacts.description: Brand canon: BRAND_BOOK.md, or STRATEGY.md + VERBAL_IDENTITY.md (+ VISUAL_IDENTITY.md for visual deliverables), optionally plus CONTENT_PILLARS.md or a content brief from brand-content-system.

constraints.description: e.g. budget cap, legal/compliance rule, technical limitation, hard deadline.

prior_run.description: Path to prior CREATIVE_BRIEF.md set. Required when mode is UPDATE.
